rows.label: Take-home pay you want

rows.label: Hours clients pay for
rows.say: Clients pay for 1,152 hours a year

rows.label: Costs and tax set-aside
rows.why: $6,000 of yearly business costs plus a 25% tax set-aside of $10,020.

rows.label: What you take home
rows.why: $46,080 less $16,020. That is $15.66 for each hour you actually work.

rows.label: Short of your $60,000
